ccs-install/add-instructions.title: Add The CCS Instructions To Grok Bot
ccs-install/add-instructions.description: Save the CCS methods and check that your Bot can read them.
ccs-install/add-instructions.content:
In this step, you’ll give Grok Bot the CCS instructions for researching buyers, building offers, preparing lead lists, writing emails and handling replies.

These instructions explain the methods, checks and rules it should follow.

**You’ll finish with a Bot called CCS Chief and the CCS instructions saved for it to use.**

Before starting, make sure you can open Grok Bot and receive a reply.

## 1. Download The CCS Instructions

[Download The CCS Instruction Pack](/api/resources/download?file=ccs-ai-pack.zip).

Open the downloaded ZIP file and extract its contents. Then open the folder called **ai-pack**.

Inside, you’ll find:

- **README.md:** explains what the pack contains.
- **AGENTS.md:** explains the AI’s jobs and working rules.
- **manifest.json:** lists the instructions included in this version.
- **skills:** contains the instructions for each task.
- **templates:** contains files you’ll fill in during later lessons.

A **skill** is a saved set of instructions that tells the AI how to do a particular job.

## 2. Create Your CCS Bot

In Grok Bot:

1. Click the **+** button in the sidebar.
2. If a menu appears, choose **Create a Bot**.
3. Name it **CCS Chief**.
4. Click **Create**.

This opens its chat. CCS Chief will be your main point of contact as you build the system. [Official Bot creation instructions](https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/bots).

## 3. Attach The Instruction Files

Use the attachment control in the chat to add these three files from **ai-pack**:

- README.md
- AGENTS.md
- manifest.json

Then open the **skills** folder, select all **16 files**, and attach those to the same message.

**You should have 19 attachments before sending.** Grok Bot’s desktop app supports up to 20 attachments per message. [Official attachment instructions](https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/files-and-results).

Keep the templates for later lessons. Each lesson will tell you which one to use.

## 4. Copy And Send This Message

Paste this into the chat with the files attached:

~~~text
You are CCS Chief. Help me build my agency’s cold-email system using the attached CCS instructions.

Read README.md, AGENTS.md and manifest.json first.

Save the 16 attached task instructions as private skills. Use the exact skill names listed in manifest.json. Preserve their instructions and approval rules.

Keep the source files available for future tasks.

When finished, show me:
1. Which skills you successfully saved.
2. Any skill you could not save.
3. Where I can inspect the saved skills.
4. Anything I still need to do.

My business details will be added in the next lesson. Do not invent them or start researching buyers yet.

Do not connect accounts, send messages, book meetings, spend money or start scheduled tasks during this setup.

Only call a skill installed after you have checked that it was saved and is available to use.
~~~

## 5. Check That The Instructions Were Saved

A message saying “done” is not the completion check.

In Grok Bot:

1. Open **Connect apps** in the sidebar.
2. Click the connected-items count beside its heading.
3. Open **Private skills**.
4. Check that the 16 CCS skills appear.
5. Enable them for CCS Chief where needed.

Private skills are saved instructions your Bots can reuse. [Official private-skill instructions](https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/skills-routines-and-automations).

## 6. Check That CCS Chief Can Read One

Send this:

~~~text
Open the saved market-research skill.

Tell me what information you need from me before using it and what work it will produce.

Show me one instruction from the saved skill so I can compare it with the file I uploaded.

Do not start the research yet.
~~~

Compare its answer with market-research.md in your **skills** folder.

You’re ready to continue when the saved skills are visible and CCS Chief can correctly read the instruction you checked.

## If Something Is Missing

If an attachment failed, attach that file again.

If Grok cannot save or find a skill, keep the error message and ask for help in CCS. Include a screenshot and the name of the missing skill.

## Your Next Step

[Tell The AI About Your Agency](/resources/ccs-install/agency-profile).

Next, you’ll give CCS Chief your service, current offer, client examples and genuine results. This gives it the facts it needs to research buyers and help build your offer.

ccs-install/agency-profile.title: Tell The AI About Your Agency
ccs-install/agency-profile.description: Give the AI the facts it needs before it makes recommendations.
ccs-install/agency-profile.content:
The AI needs to know what your agency sells, what you can deliver and which results you can prove.

You’ll give it those facts once and check the summary it saves. Later tasks will use the same information.

**You’ll finish with three files: your agency profile, your approved proof and your starting settings.** These are plain-text documents the AI reads before it works.

## 1. Gather Your Business Information

Have these ready:

- Your business name and website.
- The service you sell and who currently buys it.
- Your current price and payment terms.
- What you deliver yourself and what your client does.
- Any results, case studies or testimonials you have permission to use.
- The countries you serve and how much extra work you can handle.
- Your time zone and the tools you already pay for.

Use the figures you know. If you do not know your average client lifetime or delivery cost, say so. You can add them later.

## 2. Attach The Three Starting Templates

Open **ai-pack → templates** from the downloaded pack.

Attach **profile.md**, **approved-proof.md** and **settings.md** to CCS Chief. Add your current offer or proof documents where useful.

Use material you have permission to share. Keep passwords and API keys out of these files.

[Get The Profile Template](/api/resources/download?file=ai-pack/templates/profile.md) · [Get The Proof Template](/api/resources/download?file=ai-pack/templates/approved-proof.md) · [Get The Settings Template](/api/resources/download?file=ai-pack/templates/settings.md)

## 3. Paste Your Information And This Instruction

~~~text
Help me complete the three attached templates for getting clients for my own agency.

Use a folder called clients/my-agency/ on your computer. The campaign context is agency-acquisition.

Read the information and documents I supply. Complete profile.md, approved-proof.md and settings.md using only those facts. Ask me together for any missing information that prevents the next step. Write UNKNOWN for facts I cannot confirm.

Record my current offer and price as the starting position, not as an approved new offer.

For each case study, record the exact result, time period, source and whether the business may be named. If I have no approved proof, write NONE APPROVED.

Keep settings in DRAFT mode with external writes disabled until you approve a specific action. Leave tool permissions and campaign settings unknown until we check them.

Show me the completed files and your unanswered questions. Do not research buyers, create campaigns, spend or send anything yet.
~~~

Add your business information below the instruction and send it.

## 4. Read The Files It Returns

Open each file in Grok Bot and check it against your actual business.

**profile.md** should explain what you sell and can deliver. It must distinguish your agency from a client you might later run campaigns for.

**approved-proof.md** should contain only genuine, permitted claims. An example in this course is not your result.

**settings.md** should name the current folder and time zone. It should still show that sending and spending are off.

Tell CCS Chief what is wrong and have it update the same files. Keep a downloaded copy for yourself.

## What A Finished Result Looks Like

In our [worked example](/resources/ccs-resources/worked-example), the agency sells cold email to maintenance companies. The agency’s buyer is the maintenance-company owner.

A campaign delivered for that maintenance company would target manufacturing buyers instead. It gets its own folder, proof and calendar.

[Read The Example Profile](/api/resources/download?file=example/profile.md).

## Before You Continue

You should be able to ask CCS Chief what your agency sells, which folder it is using and what proof it may use, and get correct answers.

If it mixes your agency with your client, correct the profile before research. If it cannot reopen a saved file, ask it where the file was saved and check that location.

## Your Next Step

[Research Buyers And Build Your Offer](/resources/ccs-install/buyers-offer).

ccs-install/buyers-offer.title: Research Buyers And Build Your Offer
ccs-install/buyers-offer.description: Choose buyers who can value your work and put the scope and price in writing.
ccs-install/buyers-offer.content:
This step turns the facts about your agency into one offer you can take to market.

The AI researches possible buyers and writes the first draft. You check the evidence, choose the direction and review the terms with CCS.

**You’ll finish with a research brief, an offer and clear rules for which companies fit.**

## 1. Understand What Makes A Buyer Worth More

The same service can be worth more to a business that earns more from each new customer, closes more suitable enquiries or can fulfil more work.

A large customer value alone is not enough. Check how long a sale takes, whether the business can handle more customers and whether you can reach its buyers.

For this cold-email path, Matt’s method looks for established businesses with valuable customer relationships and a working sales process. Staffing firms, marketing agencies and public-procurement-only businesses are poor starting targets in this method.

Read [Why The Same Work Can Be Worth More](/resources/ccs-resources/go-to-market/deal-economics) if you need the explanation before choosing.

## 2. Ask For A Researched Buyer Recommendation

Attach **research-brief.md**, **fit-rules.md** and **offer.md** from the templates folder. CCS Chief already has your profile and approved proof.

~~~text
Read clients/my-agency/profile.md and approved-proof.md. Use market-research to compare three buyer groups that fit what we can genuinely deliver.

For each group, show what they sell, who they need to reach, why our work could be valuable, how we can find the decision-maker, known sales-cycle evidence and important exclusions.

Use real sources. Find current reasons to contact these buyers and buyer statements with links. Separate quotes, facts and assumptions. Do not invent a company event, customer value, profit or quotation to fill a quota.

Recommend one group and explain the trade-off. Save research-brief.md and draft fit-rules.md in clients/my-agency/. Stop for my choice before writing the final offer.
~~~

Open the sources behind the recommendation. Check a few actual businesses yourself. Choose the group you can serve, rather than the one with the biggest unverified number.

## 3. Define What Your Client Receives

Once you choose the group, ask the AI to use **offer-builder**.

For the qualified-opportunity model, write down all four conditions:

1. The person has expressed interest.
2. They can buy or transact.
3. The potential deal is worth the client’s time.
4. Their need fits the client’s service and location.

Agree the exact stage the client values, such as a needs review or a submitted loan packet. A calendar entry alone does not prove all four.

~~~text
Use offer-builder with my chosen buyer group, research brief and actual delivery ability.

Draft offer.md with: who we help; the business result they want; what we build and operate; what the client does; the definition and evidence of a qualified opportunity; the term; price; payment triggers; a proposed minimum and remedy; and the next step.

Show the difference between a delivery target and a guaranteed minimum. Use the client’s known revenue value and period without guessing profit or a close rate.

Explain what money collected at the start pays for. Keep any unagreed commercial choice clearly marked for review. Do not write outreach or publish the offer yet.
~~~

## 4. Review The Price And Terms With CCS

Bring the draft, sources and your delivery costs to a CCS call. Be ready to explain why the buyer values the outcome and how you will deliver it.

Matt’s source examples include a fixed quarter, half paid at the start, milestone payments and a modest minimum with a clear remedy. These are structures to assess, not a price every student should copy.

A promise must say what counts, when the clock starts, what the client must do and what happens if the minimum is missed.

[See The Pricing And Payment Lesson](/resources/ccs-resources/go-to-market/pricing).

## What A Finished Result Looks Like

Our example distinguishes the agency’s cold-email service from the maintenance company’s own work. It records a 90-day term, a $6,000 illustrative fee, payment triggers and an opportunity definition.

[Read The Example Offer](/api/resources/download?file=example/offer.md). The example is for learning; it is not proof of a student result.

## Before You Continue

Read the offer aloud. A new person should understand who buys, what they receive, what it costs and what they must do.

Save the chosen offer and fit rules in the same folder. If the research is weak or the terms depend on facts you do not know, take those exact questions to CCS before using the offer.

## Your Next Step

[Connect Your Tools And Set Your Budget](/resources/ccs-install/connect-tools).

ccs-install/connect-tools.title: Connect Your Tools And Set Your Budget
ccs-install/connect-tools.description: Check the accounts, sending inboxes and permissions before a campaign is prepared.
ccs-install/connect-tools.content:
Your offer is now written down. This step prepares the accounts that will find contacts, send approved emails and manage your calendar.

**You’ll finish with a list of the accounts you own, checked sending inboxes, a cost plan and the settings your AI needs.** You sign in and approve access. The AI checks what it can read and reports anything missing.

## 1. Check What You Already Have

Open **settings.md** from your agency folder. List your current sending tool, lead-data tool, domains, inboxes and calendar.

For this walkthrough, the default tools are **Grok Bot, Instantly, AI Ark and your scheduling calendar**. Existing suitable accounts can be reused. This choice follows the current CCS resource setup; a different tool needs its own connection and field checks.

The downloadable pack uses supervised operation. It starts with external writes disabled. Approve each specific setup or operating action only after its connection and inputs have been checked. The worked example does not connect your real accounts.

## 2. Prepare Instantly And Your Sending Inboxes

[Open Instantly](https://app.instantly.ai).

Instantly sends campaign emails from inboxes you connect. For the event-triggered reply workflow, its **Hyper Growth** plan currently costs **$107/month** and includes webhooks. A webhook is a notification sent to your Bot when an event happens, such as an interested reply. [Plans](https://help.instantly.ai/en/articles/10273259-instantly-plans-overview) · [Webhook guide](https://help.instantly.ai/en/articles/6261906-webhooks).

Before paying, check your existing plan. You can prepare files and review the example before purchasing sending tools.

For sending inboxes, open [ScaledMail](https://www.scaledmail.com/pricing) and request a setup sized to your initial sending volume. Its current Google mailbox reference price is $3.50/month per mailbox; domain and package charges need checking at checkout.

Ask the provider to confirm the domains, inboxes, authentication, warm-up and how the inboxes connect to your Instantly workspace. Use the provider’s secure access process rather than sending passwords in chat.

Matt’s standard is about two weeks of warm-up for new inboxes, followed by a cautious start. Check the actual health and provider limits before sending. Group inboxes into **A** and **B** so one group can rest while the other sends.

[Read The Full Sending Setup Lesson](/resources/ccs-resources/client-acquisition/setup).

## 3. Prepare Your Lead-Data And Calendar Accounts

[Open AI Ark](https://app.ai-ark.com). Check that you can search the chosen company types and relevant job titles. Its public starting paid plan is currently $49/month for 5,000 credits. Check the count and credit cost before approving an export. [Current AI Ark plans](https://ai-ark.com/pricing).

For scheduling, reuse your current tool if it works with the intended setup. [Calendly Free](https://calendly.com/pricing) includes one event type and one calendar connection. Standard adds multiple calendars and reminders; it is not automatically needed just to begin.

Calendly’s November 2026 update makes its Scheduling API available on Free as well. A particular connector or webhook may have different requirements, so check the actual route you will use. [Scheduling API update](https://developer.calendly.com/release-notes/2026/11/3).

Write the event link, meeting length, host, time zone and calendars that must be checked into settings.md.

## 4. Give The AI Safe Access

In Grok Bot, use **Connect apps** where the required app is supported. For browser sign-in, follow its secure sign-in handoff. Store API keys in secure secret storage, using a label such as **Instantly API key** in your notes, never the key itself.

Ask for a read-only check first:

~~~text
Read clients/my-agency/settings.md. Help me check the accounts needed for this setup.

List the account and workspace each connection belongs to, what you can read, what you cannot access and which next task requires it. Guide me through secure sign-in only where necessary.

Read settings and existing account information only. Do not change permissions, create webhooks, load a campaign, send, book, buy or start a routine.

If an integration is unsupported, name the missing function and show the manual route for review. Never invent an API endpoint or call a saved login a tested integration.
~~~

Read the account names it reports. A login to the wrong workspace is not a successful connection.

## 5. Write Your Budget Before A Paid Run

[Download The Budget Worksheet](/api/resources/download?file=ai-pack/templates/budget.csv).

Add recurring subscriptions, inboxes, domain renewals and any extra data or model charges. Show annual bills separately from their monthly share.

For a paid sample, set a maximum spend first. Use the sample’s actual usage to estimate a full list: **cost per company × number of companies**. Approve that full amount before a larger run.

[See The Filled Budget Example](/api/resources/download?file=example/budget.md). Its allowances are illustrative, not a quote for your setup.

## Before You Continue

Your settings should identify the correct accounts, inbox groups, calendar and limits. You should know which connections were checked and which still need help.

If access fails, save the exact error and ask CCS with the account name and task. Keep credentials private. Do not keep retrying a failed action that could charge or send.

## Set Up The Other Five Bots

CCS Chief coordinates the work. The other Bots have narrower jobs. Use the same **+ → Create A Bot** steps you used for Chief, then create:

- **CCS Research:** market-research and offer-builder.
- **CCS List Builder:** signal-list-builder, lead-list-cleaner, website-scraper, lead-fit-scoring, enrichment-variables and sequencer-uploader.
- **CCS Copywriter:** cold-email-copy.
- **CCS Campaign Monitor:** weekly-campaign-report, daily-scoreboard, sending-domain-blacklist and campaign-vault.
- **CCS Reply Agent:** interested-reply-qualify, inbox-manager and meeting-booking.

Enable the listed private skills for each Bot through **Connect apps → connected-items count → Private skills**. Give each Bot AGENTS.md and the location **clients/my-agency/**. Ask it to describe its job and open the current files before you continue.

~~~text
Use AGENTS.md and the skills assigned to your named role. Work only in clients/my-agency/ for agency-acquisition. Read the files required for this stage. Tell me your assigned skills, which files you can read and anything missing. Do not connect extra accounts, create routines, send, book, upload or spend. Keep external writes disabled for this read-only connection check.
~~~

All Bots on one Grok account share the computer and files. A different Bot name is a work role, not a privacy boundary.

## Your Next Step

[Prepare Your Website And Sales Materials](/resources/ccs-install/sales-materials).

ccs-install/sales-materials.title: Prepare Your Website And Sales Materials
ccs-install/sales-materials.description: Give prospects a clear explanation and prepare for the calls you want to book.
ccs-install/sales-materials.content:
Someone who receives your email may look up your business before replying. When they book, you need a clear way to discuss the work and send a proposal.

The AI helps write these materials using your approved offer and genuine proof. You check the facts, record any video and approve what prospects see.

**You’ll finish with a clear website draft, your sales call guide, proposal structure and follow-up emails.**

## 1. Check What Prospects Can See

Open your website and LinkedIn profile as a visitor.

Can they tell what you do, which businesses you help, who runs the company and how to reach you? Do the examples and claims match your approved proof?

For this upmarket route, Matt recommends a straightforward firm website with services, industries, founder information and relevant disclosures. Explain the work in the buyer’s language.

Use the [Website Lesson](/resources/ccs-resources/funnel/website) to prepare or improve those pages. You can reuse a suitable site.

## 2. Ask The AI To Draft The Materials

Attach **sales-assets.md** and **sales-assets-instruction.md** from the pack.

~~~text
Read clients/my-agency/profile.md, research-brief.md, offer.md and approved-proof.md. Use the attached sales-asset instruction and template.

Prepare:
1. Website copy explaining who we help, what we do, how the engagement works, our genuine proof and the next step.
2. A discovery call guide that uncovers the prospect’s process, customer value, sales cycle, capacity and opportunity definition.
3. A proposal outline using only the offer and terms we have approved.
4. The five between-call email templates adapted to our offer, each labelled by its purpose and when to use it.
5. A short outline for an asset answering one recurring buyer question.

Show which facts support each claim. Mark missing material rather than inventing results. Keep everything as drafts for my review. Do not publish or send.
~~~

Review each item separately. If a claim is wrong, correct the saved source file as well as the draft so the mistake does not return later.

## 3. Decide Whether You Need A VSL

A VSL is a video that explains your offer before a sales call. It can be useful when prospects need more context, but the first email does not need a long video to make sense.

If a VSL is part of your agreed route, use the [VSL Lesson And Script](/resources/ccs-resources/funnel/vsl). The AI drafts the script; you check it and record it. Watch the final video and test the page on your phone.

## 4. Prepare Your Two-Call Sales Process

On the first call, understand the business and show an honest price range where appropriate. Send a short scope after the call. Use the second call to review the proposal with the people who decide.

[Discovery Script](/api/resources/download?file=ai-pack/templates/discovery-script.md) · [Between-Call Emails](/api/resources/download?file=ai-pack/templates/between-calls-emails.md) · [Proposal Template](/api/resources/download?file=ai-pack/templates/proposal.md).

A final proposal is written from the real conversation. Leave it as a template until those facts exist. Do not send a generic proposal containing guessed deal values.

## What A Finished Result Looks Like

The [worked example](/resources/ccs-resources/worked-example) includes discovery notes and a proposal. Read them side by side to see how the prospect’s answers become the proposed scope.

Your own materials should use your business name, genuine proof, agreed offer and working call link.

## Before You Continue

Open the site and booking link on desktop and phone. Read the script aloud. Check the proposal terms and every claim.

Take unfinished buyer questions or unclear terms to CCS. A polished page does not fix an offer that is still unclear.

## Your Next Step

[Build And Check Your First Lead List](/resources/ccs-install/first-lead-list).

ccs-install/first-lead-list.title: Build And Check Your First Lead List
ccs-install/first-lead-list.description: Find suitable people, check the companies and keep uncertain rows out of the campaign.
ccs-install/first-lead-list.content:
Your offer and buyer rules are ready. Now you need real people at companies that fit those rules.

The AI prepares the search, cleans the export and researches company websites. You check a small sample before using the full list.

**You’ll finish with a checked lead list, a record of held and removed rows, and a saved search you can repeat.**

## 1. Prepare The Search Before Exporting

Open the **CCS List Builder** Bot if already created. Otherwise ask CCS Chief to help create a Bot with that job, using the List Builder role from AGENTS.md and the saved list skills.

Give it your agency folder and attach **lead-recipe.md** and **field-map.md**.

~~~text
Use signal-list-builder with clients/my-agency/research-brief.md, offer.md and fit-rules.md.

Prepare a people search for the approved company types, locations and buying titles. Apply the exclusions. Show the search filters, source, expected count and credit cost before any paid export.

Save the search or its exact filters in lead-recipe.md. Keep the campaign context agency-acquisition. Do not export paid data or load a campaign yet.
~~~

Open the search. Check actual companies and titles. Approve a small export only when the audience and cost make sense.

## 2. Clean The Export

Keep the original download as **leads-raw.csv**. A CSV is a spreadsheet-style file of rows and columns.

Ask List Builder to run **lead-list-cleaner**. It should remove duplicates, blank emails, excluded contacts and known opt-outs. Keep uncertain domains or secure-email-gateway contacts in a separate held file.

The AI must report: raw rows, removed rows, held rows and remaining rows. These counts must add up. It must not guess a missing email or website.

## 3. Check Company Fit On A Sample

Use **website-scraper** to collect public website evidence, then **lead-fit-scoring** to check companies against your written rules.

Select 50 companies and label them yourself:

- **GOOD:** the available evidence matches the rules.
- **BAD:** a clear rule excludes them.
- **MAYBE:** the evidence is missing or unclear.

Compare the AI’s labels with yours. Read every disagreement, correct the rule and test a fresh sample. A high match on one sample is a useful check, not a guarantee about the next list.

[Read The Qualification Lesson](/resources/ccs-resources/client-acquisition/qualification).

## 4. Prepare The Final File

~~~text
Use the approved fit rules and corrected scoring instructions to prepare leads-qualified.csv.

Keep GOOD rows only. Put uncertain rows in leads-held.csv with a plain reason and the next check needed. Put rejected rows in leads-rejected.csv with the rejection reason.

Use the field-map names. Keep source links and research notes for checking, not as automatic email text. Report counts and the scoring version.

Do not invent missing facts, use another client’s rules, spend beyond approval or upload the list.
~~~

Open several rows yourself. Check that the email, name, role, company and domain belong together.

## What A Finished Result Looks Like

In the [local example](/resources/ccs-resources/worked-example), 58 synthetic rows become 50 clean rows, with four removed and four held. The company check produces 30 GOOD, ten BAD and ten MAYBE results.

These are practice records on .example domains, not real prospects.

[Raw List](/api/resources/download?file=example/leads-raw.csv) · [Qualified List](/api/resources/download?file=example/leads-qualified.csv) · [Held Rows](/api/resources/download?file=example/leads-held.csv).

## Before You Continue

You should have a repeatable search, reconciled row counts, a checked sample and a file containing only approved contacts.

If a website cannot be read, use the public-browser fallback or hold the row. Missing evidence is not a reason to mark a company GOOD.

## Your Next Step

[Write, Approve And Load Your Emails](/resources/ccs-install/write-load-emails).

ccs-install/write-load-emails.title: Write, Approve And Load Your Emails
ccs-install/write-load-emails.description: Turn the offer into two emails, check every field and keep the campaign paused.
ccs-install/write-load-emails.content:
The AI now has a researched buyer, a written offer and a checked list. It can write an email that makes sense to that buyer.

**You’ll finish with approved copy and a campaign prepared for review. It stays paused.**

## 1. Give The Copywriter The Approved Inputs

Use a **CCS Copywriter** Bot with the Copywriter job in AGENTS.md. Give it your profile, research brief, offer and approved proof. Attach **copy-locked.md**.

~~~text
Use cold-email-copy for clients/my-agency/. Read the current research brief, offer, profile and approved proof first.

Draft two variants of the first email and one short follow-up in the same thread. Follow the skill’s two-step structure. Make the offer and reply ask clear. Use the researched buyer language without inventing a personal event or claim.

Show the subject, each email and which source supports its claims. Keep list building and campaign loading out of this task. Stop for my copy review.
~~~

Read the email as if you have never heard of your agency. Can you tell what is being offered and why it could be useful?

## 2. Check And Lock The Copy

Correct the draft, then save the approved version in **copy-locked.md** with a version and date.

Write the subject and both steps exactly as you approve them. Locking means the uploader uses that text without rewriting it.

The CCS email method uses a first-name subject and one short follow-up. Research notes stay internal unless an approved line uses them.

[Read The Email Copy Lesson](/resources/ccs-resources/client-acquisition/email-copy).

## 3. Map And Preview The Fields

A merge field inserts a person’s name or another saved value into an email.

The pack uses **first_name** as its working column. Instantly’s first-name field uses **{{firstName}}**. Map the column to its First name field and check the rendered preview. [Instantly variable guide](https://help.instantly.ai/en/articles/6135930-how-to-add-and-use-variables-in-campaigns).

Preview real rows from the approved list. The subject should show the person’s actual name. A blank field, visible braces, an error message or the wrong company means the row needs fixing.

## 4. Prepare The Campaign Paused

For Instantly, open **Campaigns**, create the campaign, add the approved list, set the sequence, select sending inboxes and check the schedule and options. Use the [official campaign guide](https://help.instantly.ai/en/articles/6451970-quick-start-guide-all-in-one) for the current screen labels.

The review pack cannot make live changes. You can practise with the local example first. Any real import needs separate approval and must remain paused.

~~~text
Use sequencer-uploader with the current leads-qualified.csv, copy-locked.md, field-map.md and settings.md.

Prepare the campaign plan. Confirm the account, workspace, list count, sender group, subject mapping, both steps, follow-up delay, sending hours and time zone.

Keep stop-on-reply on, open/link tracking off and the campaign paused. Use only the exact approved copy. Show rendered sample emails and all settings for review.

For practice, simulate the load using the example files. For your real campaign, review the exact list, locked copy, account and settings, then explicitly approve loading them into a paused campaign. Check the actual imported rows and emails before proceeding. Loading is not approval to activate or send.
~~~

## 5. Check The Prepared Campaign

Compare the final copy with your locked file. Check:

- Lead count and no opt-outs or held rows.
- Correct sending account and inbox group.
- Both email steps, with step two in the same thread.
- Approved delay and sending time zone.
- Stop-on-reply on.
- Open and link tracking off for this plain-text path.
- Paused status.

A preview email is not permission to send a test. Internal tests also need approved copy and recipients.

## What A Finished Result Looks Like

[Open The Locked Copy Example](/api/resources/download?file=example/copy-locked.md).

The local example produces a simulated paused campaign with 30 qualified contacts. It does not upload contacts to Instantly.

## If Something Is Wrong

Keep the campaign paused. Fix the source file and regenerate the preview. If copy, recipients, sender or settings change, obtain the relevant approval again.

## Your Next Step

[Test Replies And Meeting Booking](/resources/ccs-install/reply-test).

ccs-install/reply-test.title: Test Replies And Meeting Booking
ccs-install/reply-test.description: Check how the AI handles fit, drafts, calendars and mistakes before real replies arrive.
ccs-install/reply-test.content:
A positive reply only helps if it reaches the right person and becomes a useful conversation.

This step teaches your AI inbox manager what to check, what to draft and when to ask you.

**You’ll finish with reply rules and a completed practice check. Real sending and booking stay off until separately approved.**

## 1. Give The Reply Agent Its Instructions

Create **CCS Reply Agent** with the Reply Agent job from AGENTS.md. Give it the current profile, offer, fit rules, settings and **voice-and-replies.md**.

Add three to five replies that sound like you, with private details removed. Explain what you like about them.

Ask it to save those samples as **voice-samples.md**, your editing rules as **voice-rules.md**, and the approved reply shapes as **reply-templates.md** in the same client folder. Keep **fit-rules.md** as the single source for fit. These are the files the inbox-manager skill reads.

~~~text
Use voice-and-replies.md to prepare voice-samples.md, voice-rules.md and reply-templates.md in clients/my-agency/. Preserve my real examples and mark any new example as a draft. Do not change fit-rules.md, infer proof or send anything. Show me the saved files for review.
~~~

Ask it to use **interested-reply-qualify**, **inbox-manager** and **meeting-booking**.

## 2. Set The Reply Rules

For each interested reply, the AI should show a decision card: who replied, what was offered, the latest message, company fit, its reason, proposed reply and real available times with a time zone.

**GOOD** means the known facts fit. **UNSURE** means you need to check something. **BAD** means a clear exclusion applies.

An opt-out stops contact. A request to speak later gets a dated reminder. A referral is a new recipient to review. The AI must not invent a different price or extra service to win a reply.

[Read The Daily Reply Lesson](/resources/ccs-training/daily-replies).

## 3. Run The Practice Cases

~~~text
Read the current clients/my-agency/ files. Use interested-reply-qualify, inbox-manager and meeting-booking.

Run a draft-only exercise for:
1. A suitable person asking for more information.
2. A person whose company fit is unclear.
3. A bad-fit person.
4. Someone asking to be removed.
5. A suitable person accepting a meeting time that is no longer free.

Use clearly labelled practice messages and no real recipients. Show the fit decision, evidence, draft where appropriate, required approval and next action.

Do not send, book, invite, create a webhook or change a live contact. If the current pack blocks an action, keep it blocked.
~~~

Read the results. The unclear person should be held for review. The opt-out should receive no persuasive follow-up. The unavailable time should not be silently replaced with another time.

## 4. Check The Booking Route

For a future real booking, both the scheduling rules and the connected calendar must show the time as available. The person, email, meeting length, host and time zone must match.

Do not create a separate calendar event if the scheduler already sent the invitation. Check the actual booking first.

For practice, inspect the [simulated booking record](/api/resources/download?file=example/simulation.json). It is not a live meeting.

## 5. Confirm The Approval Boundary

Before a future send, the AI must reread the latest thread and compare the approved copy, recipient, sender and channel. A changed thread or draft needs a new review.

Use one action at a time and check the result before moving on. If delivery is unclear, inspect the conversation rather than retrying.

Interested-reply follow-ups are separate from the cold-email sequence. The coaching runbook uses draft reminders about 24 hours after offering times, then one day later, then two days later. They stop if the person replies, books or opts out. This timing still needs final CCS operating approval.

## Before You Continue

You should have correct results for the practice cases and a written list of any untested connection.

If a case fails, show CCS the message, rule and wrong result. Keep the exact error. Do not begin live reply handling while a critical problem remains.

## Your Next Step

[Review And Launch Your Campaign With CCS](/resources/ccs-install/launch-review).

ccs-install/launch-review.title: Review And Launch Your Campaign With CCS
ccs-install/launch-review.description: Bring the whole setup to review and separate launch approval from practice results.
ccs-install/launch-review.content:
The files, copy and reply practice are ready. Now check the whole setup together.

**This page prepares the launch review. A completed local example does not authorise live sending.**

## 1. Bring The Completed Setup

Have these ready for CCS:

- Your profile, research brief and approved offer.
- Fit rules, the lead recipe and checked sample.
- The qualified list with raw, held and removed counts.
- Locked copy and rendered email previews.
- Sending account, inbox groups, limits and schedule.
- Reply practice results and the correct booking link.
- Tool costs, spending limits and unresolved problems.

Keep the latest versions in one agency folder. Use a short list of questions so the review can focus on actual gaps.

## 2. Check The Campaign Together

Open the actual workspace you intend to use. Compare its campaign, lead count, copy, fields, senders and settings with the files.

Check that inboxes are ready, held contacts are excluded and the campaign remains paused. Confirm who owns replies and who can approve sending.

The reviewer should be able to follow the same files and see why each decision was made.

## 3. Agree Any Internal Test Before Sending It

A live delivery test needs the exact message, sender, controlled recipient accounts and channel approved in advance.

Once approved, send one test, inspect the received message and actual conversation, then decide whether to continue. A failed or ambiguous result stops the test. Do not use a prospect as a transport test.

The worked example has not performed this real-account test. Record it as **NOT TESTED** until it actually happens.

## 4. Approve The Actual Launch

Launch approval identifies the campaign, approved audience, copy version, sender group, schedule, limits and person monitoring the first run.

The owner activates the campaign only after the required checks and approvals. AI preparation or a reply saying “ready” is not activation authority.

Keep the first run small enough to inspect. Review actual sends, errors and replies before increasing volume.

## 5. Record What Happened

~~~text
Prepare a launch-review note from the current files and any evidence I supply.

Separate: checked files; local simulations; actual account tests; approvals; actions actually completed; open problems.

List the campaign and exact versions reviewed. If a live test or launch has not happened, write NOT TESTED or NOT LAUNCHED. Do not fill the gap with simulated results.

Do not send, activate or change anything.
~~~

## Before You Continue

Continue to a real handover only after the working chain has been demonstrated: approved campaign, correctly handled qualified reply and booking, working monitoring and no unresolved critical setup failure.

One qualified booking demonstrates that the chain works. It does not establish profitable or repeatable acquisition.

## Your Next Step

[Complete Your Handover](/resources/ccs-install/handover).

ccs-install/handover.title: Complete Your Handover
ccs-install/handover.description: Save what was installed, what was demonstrated and what you do next week.
ccs-install/handover.content:
Your handover is the record of your actual setup. It lets you and your AI keep running the system without rebuilding it from memory.

**You’ll finish with one completed handover pack and a clear daily and weekly routine.**

## 1. Complete Your Own Handover Pack

[Download The Handover Template](/api/resources/download?file=ai-pack/templates/handover-pack.md).

Ask CCS Chief to gather the actual information:

~~~text
Use the handover template and the current clients/my-agency/ files.

Record the business, offer, opportunity definition, list recipe, scoring rules, locked copy, campaign names, inbox groups, limits, sending time zone, calendar, reply rules and approved follow-up timing.

List each routine with its owning Bot, trigger, time zone, output, last successful test and whether it is actually active.

Include actual demonstration evidence, unresolved issues, and next week’s actions. Separate live results from practice results. If a component is not installed or tested, say so.

Never include passwords or API key values. Return the draft for CCS and my review. Do not activate anything.
~~~

## 2. Walk Through It With CCS

Read the pack before the walkthrough. Open the saved files, actual campaign and current reports together.

Show that you can find an interested reply, read its decision card, check a proposed time, see unused leads and understand the weekly report.

Correct the pack while you review it. Record who checked the setup and when.

## 3. Confirm What Is Ready

The real handover needs evidence that the system works in the selected accounts, including a correctly qualified booking and working monitoring.

A missing connection, failed approval check or uncertain booking remains open. Keep the system supervised while those problems are resolved.

[Read The Practice Handover](/api/resources/download?file=example/handover-pack.md). It is clearly marked as a simulation and not ready for a real student handover.

## 4. Set Your Next Week

Your pack should identify:

- When you review replies each weekday.
- When the weekly report is due.
- When the lead list needs refilling.
- Which approved email variation is next.
- Which problems need CCS help.
- Who owns each action.

You should be able to explain that week without asking the AI to invent a new strategy.

## If You Are Not Ready Yet

Keep the incomplete items visible. Ask CCS about the specific failed step and continue only the work that does not depend on it.

Do not mark a tool installed, a routine active or a campaign successful because a practice example worked.

## Your Next Step

[Start CCS Training](/resources/ccs-training/start).

Use Training to operate the demonstrated setup. The detailed Resources remain available whenever you need help with one part.

ccs-resources/worked-example.title: Follow One Agency From First Setup To Handover
ccs-resources/worked-example.description: Read the same completed files through research, offer, leads, campaign, reply practice and reporting.
ccs-resources/worked-example.content:
You do not need to buy any tools to follow this example. Open the files below as you read. They show what you and your AI should produce at each step.

**This is an illustrative teaching case.** The company names and lead rows are made up. The process tests run locally. No real campaign, message or meeting was created.

## 1. Understand The Business And The Two Campaigns

The example agency sells cold-email services to industrial maintenance companies. Those companies maintain equipment for manufacturers.

For the agency's own campaign, the buyer is a maintenance-company owner. For a maintenance client's delivery campaign, the buyer might be a plant manager. The offer, proof, sender and calendar must match the right campaign.

Open the [completed profile](/api/resources/download?file=example/profile.md), [proof file](/api/resources/download?file=example/approved-proof.md), [fit rules](/api/resources/download?file=example/fit-rules.md) and [settings](/api/resources/download?file=example/settings.md). Notice that there are no approved past results and no live account connections.

## 2. Research Buyers, Then Build The Offer

The [research brief](/api/resources/download?file=example/research-brief.md) contains ten short language notes from five real public sources. It separates what those sources say from the assumptions used in this exercise.

The [discovery notes](/api/resources/download?file=example/discovery-notes.md) supply the missing facts for a constructed sales conversation. They do not pretend to be a real transcript.

Read the [completed offer](/api/resources/download?file=example/offer.md) and [proposal](/api/resources/download?file=example/proposal.md). They agree on these terms:

- A 90-day engagement with a target of ten accepted opportunities.
- A $6,000 service fee, $3,000 before build and $3,000 after five accepted opportunities.
- A written definition of an accepted opportunity. A booking alone does not count.
- An initial-payment refund if no accepted opportunity is produced within 45 sending days, under the stated participation terms.
- The maintenance company performs its technical sales and maintenance work.

The target, minimum protection and final customer sale are three different things.

The [completed website copy](/api/resources/download?file=example/website-brief.md) and [spoken script](/api/resources/download?file=example/vsl-script.md) use those same facts. They are drafts, not a published site or recorded video.

## 3. Check What The Numbers Mean

If ten opportunities eventually produced two customers worth $60,000 each in first-year revenue, those customers would bring $120,000 in revenue. That is twenty times the $6,000 agency fee.

**The two sales are an assumption, not a forecast.** This does not mean $120,000 arrives this month, and it is not buyer profit. The example proposal does not claim that result.

Read the [filled budget](/api/resources/download?file=example/budget.md). It separates monthly allocation from actual first-month cash and makes the paid calendar optional.

## 4. Follow Every Lead Row

Open the [lead recipe](/api/resources/download?file=example/lead-recipe.md), then compare:

| File | Rows | Why |
|---|---:|---|
| [Raw List](/api/resources/download?file=example/leads-raw.csv) | 58 | All practice input rows. |
| [Rejected Rows](/api/resources/download?file=example/leads-rejected.csv) | 4 | Invalid, duplicate, suppressed or free-email rows. |
| [Held Rows](/api/resources/download?file=example/leads-held.csv) | 4 | Missing fields or uncertain mail route. |
| [Clean List](/api/resources/download?file=example/leads-clean.csv) | 50 | Ready for company review, not all approved to contact. |
| [Labelled Sample](/api/resources/download?file=example/labels-50.csv) | 50 | 30 GOOD, 10 BAD, 10 MAYBE. |
| [Qualified List](/api/resources/download?file=example/leads-qualified.csv) | 30 | Only the GOOD practice rows. |

58 = 4 rejected + 4 held + 50 clean. Of the 50 clean rows, 30 qualify. Nothing disappears from the record.

The classifier in this demonstration uses simple fixed rules. Its agreement with these synthetic labels does not measure a real AI's accuracy. You must hand-check real companies before a live campaign.

## 5. Read The Emails Before Loading

Open [locked copy](/api/resources/download?file=example/copy-locked.md) and the [field map](/api/resources/download?file=example/field-map.md). The source field **first_name** becomes Instantly's native **firstName** field.

The simulation renders sample greetings and creates a paused campaign record containing 30 contacts. It cannot upload those contacts to Instantly or send a message.

A changed email, missing name or unsafe tracking setting must stop the load for review.

## 6. Practise Replies And Booking Failures

Read the [reply examples](/api/resources/download?file=example/voice-and-replies.md).

The local test uses a fixture calendar. It checks a selected time with an explicit UTC offset, requires exact approval, records a simulated booking and stops further sequence emails in its saved state.

It also checks duplicate events, a changed thread, an opt-out, a bad-fit reply, an unavailable slot and expired access. Real provider delivery, calendar conflicts and webhook recovery still need authorised account tests.

## 7. Review The Report And Handover

The [weekly report](/api/resources/download?file=example/weekly-report.md) shows 20 emails sent and ten new contacts used. Those are different counts.

Twenty new contacts remain. At ten new contacts per day, that is **two sending days left**. The next action is to prepare a refill for approval.

Read the [routine register](/api/resources/download?file=example/routine-register.md) and [completed practice handover](/api/resources/download?file=example/handover-pack.md). No routine is active. The handover lists what a real installation still needs.

The [machine-readable simulation](/api/resources/download?file=example/simulation.json) is available if you or CCS want to inspect the test output.

## Your Next Step

Return to [Start Here](/resources/ccs-install/welcome) and build your own files in order. Use these examples to check the shape of your work, not as facts about your business.

ccs-resources/go-to-market/deal-economic.title: Understand Why Some Clients Can Pay More
ccs-resources/go-to-market/deal-economic.description: See how your client's customer value changes what your work could be worth. Use this before choosing a market or a price.
ccs-resources/go-to-market/deal-economic.content:
See how your client's customer value changes what your work could be worth. Use this before choosing a market or a price.

## Start With The Result You Create

You may help a client get enquiries, applications, sales calls, purchases or another useful step towards a sale. Ask what happens after that step. How many become customers? What does each customer spend, and over what period?

**Customer lifetime value, or LTV, means the revenue one customer brings over the whole time they stay.** It does not mean profit. First-year value covers only the first year. Use the period the client actually knows.

The same service can support different fees because buyers make different amounts from the result, convert different shares of prospects and have different delivery costs.

## Work Through One Example

Suppose you create ten opportunities. If the client eventually closes two, and each brings $60,000 in first-year revenue, those customers bring $120,000 in first-year revenue.

A $6,000 agency fee is 5% of that revenue, or the revenue is twenty times the fee. It is not a 20x profit return. The client's own costs have not been deducted.

If the same ten opportunities produce only one $5,000 sale, the revenue is $5,000. That does not support the same fee in the same way.

A lower-value business can still work if it converts far more customers or buys repeatedly. **Value and conversion both matter.** High LTV alone does not make a buyer suitable.

## Fill In The Numbers They Actually Know

Download the [buyer economics worksheet](/api/resources/download?file=ai-pack/templates/buyer-economics.md).

Record the opportunities delivered, the share that becomes customers, customer revenue and period, your fee, actual sales cycle and payment timing. If the close rate is unknown, show clearly labelled low and high scenarios. Do not turn a scenario into an expected result.

For your own agency, calculate the fee collected, delivery cost and time per client. A higher fee is less useful if bespoke work uses the extra money.

## Ask Your AI To Check The Maths

~~~text
Read my buyer-economics.md. Check each calculation and its unit and time period. Separate stated facts from illustrative scenarios. Show customer revenue compared with our fee. Do not call revenue profit, assume a margin or claim the customer pays within 30 days. Show what is still unknown and which question would resolve it. Return a corrected worksheet for my review. Do not change prices or send anything.
~~~

## Check And Continue

You should be able to explain the comparison in one sentence, using the same period and stating what is assumed. If you cannot, ask the client for the missing number rather than inventing it.

Next, [Choose Clients Who Can Afford Your Service](/resources/ccs-resources/go-to-market/client-selection). Return to [Research Buyers And Build Your Offer](/resources/ccs-install/buyers-offer) when your worksheet is clear.

ccs-resources/go-to-market/client-select.title: Choose Clients Who Can Afford Your Service
ccs-resources/go-to-market/client-select.description: Finish with one buyer group, clear exclusions and a list of facts to check before you offer a price.
ccs-resources/go-to-market/client-select.content:
Finish with one buyer group, clear exclusions and a list of facts to check before you offer a price.

## Choose By Economics And Delivery Fit

An ideal client profile, or ICP, describes the companies and people you want to reach. Start with what they sell, who buys it and whether your work could create enough value. A company size filter does not answer those questions.

Check seven things: meaningful customer value, an achievable sales cycle, a private business buyer able to decide, spare delivery capacity, a service you can help sell, contacts you can identify, and enough suitable accounts for your planned campaign.

Use the [selection worksheet](/api/resources/download?file=ai-pack/templates/client-selection.md). The seven-point checklist treats six or seven positive checks as a candidate for a full engagement, four or five as a reason to investigate a smaller pilot, and three or fewer as a reason to pass. This is a teaching aid, not a formula proving fit.

## Compare Specific Business Types

Use these business types as starting points for research. They are research candidates, not eight industries guaranteed to work:

- Industrial maintenance and field service.
- Commercial cleaning or facilities contracts.
- Machine shops and fabrication.
- Equipment repair and replacement parts.
- Logistics and warehousing.
- Technical or engineering services.
- Commercial installation and specialist trades.
- Software implementation or migration.

Separate the service lines inside each group. A parts business selling $50 orders differs from one supplying large annual accounts. Capital equipment, public tenders and complex procurement may be too slow for the proposed quarter.

The initial CCS agency-acquisition screen excludes staffing/recruitment, marketing agencies and mainly consumer businesses. This is a choice for this method, not a claim that those businesses can never buy marketing.

## Separate Research From Discovery

The broad AI research screen uses an estimated sales-cycle low end below 120 days and an estimated first-year value high end above $30,000. Those are broad research settings. They do not confirm real numbers.

Before a proposal, the account-value lesson asks for a much more concrete, usually shorter path, around 30-60 days, with customer value several times the quarter fee. Confirm these on the call. Change thresholds when your service and price require it, then version the rules.

Missing evidence is MAYBE. Do not classify a blocked website as a good prospect.

## Give Your AI A Clear Job

~~~text
Compare three buyer groups using my profile, approved-proof and buyer-economics files. Fill client-selection.md. For each check, give a source, a confirmed client answer or UNKNOWN. Recommend one group and explain the trade-off. Do not invent a market count, customer value, spare capacity or successful student example. Turn the chosen group's confirmed rules into fit-rules.md. Keep broad estimates separate from proposal requirements. Stop for my review.
~~~

## Check And Continue

You finish with one company type, buying roles, service area, exclusions and missing discovery questions. The corrected rule is to investigate poor fit when too many calls are unqualified, not to treat a high qualified rate as a problem.

Next, [Research Buyers And Find A Reason To Reach Them](/resources/ccs-resources/go-to-market/research).

ccs-resources/go-to-market/research.title: Research Buyers And Find A Reason To Reach Them
ccs-resources/go-to-market/research.description: Build a research brief your AI can use to choose an angle and write relevant emails.
ccs-resources/go-to-market/research.content:
Build a research brief your AI can use to choose an angle and write relevant emails.

## Research The Right Two Groups

Your client is the business paying your agency. Their buyer is the person your work helps them reach. Write both at the top of your brief.

A useful trigger is a change that gives the buyer a reason to act: a lease move, a planned shutdown, old software losing support or a refinancing deadline. Ask who needs something because of that change, then who sells it.

A recurring situation is not a verified event at a named company. A public announcement needs a date and source before you describe it as happening now.

## Collect Evidence Before Writing

Download the [research brief](/api/resources/download?file=ai-pack/templates/research-brief.md). Collect company service pages, industry sources, buyer wording, stated alternatives, typical sales steps and possible data sources.

Use exact short quotations with links where helpful. Otherwise paraphrase. Do not join fragments into a quotation. Mark an inference as an inference and unknown figures UNKNOWN.

The [filled research exercise](/api/resources/download?file=example/research-brief.md) shows ten language notes and their limits. Those public companies are not presented as clients or willing prospects.

## Use The Research Skill

~~~text
Use the saved market-research skill. Read my profile, proof, selected buyer group and fit rules. Create research-brief.md with source links, dates, buyer wording, three possible angles, a route to find the relevant accounts, and unanswered questions. Separate my agency's client from that client's buyer. Do not invent quotations or claim a dated event without a source. Return your recommendation and what it would take to verify it. Do not buy data or launch anything.
~~~

The [full skill](/api/resources/download?file=ai-pack/skills/market-research.md) contains the detailed method. If it is not available in Grok, return to [Add The CCS Instructions](/resources/ccs-install/add-instructions), rather than assume it was saved.

## Choose An Angle You Can Deliver

A good angle names a relevant buyer, a specific need and a route to identify them. If you cannot find that buyer or your service cannot reach them, choose a different angle. Attractive wording cannot fix missing data or delivery.

## Check And Continue

Open the important source links yourself. Confirm what each supports. Give CCS the brief and your recommended angle for review through your existing CCS channel.

Next, [Create An Offer Worth Paying For](/resources/ccs-resources/go-to-market/offer).

ccs-resources/go-to-market/offer.title: Create An Offer Worth Paying For
ccs-resources/go-to-market/offer.description: Turn your service into a clear result, a defined body of work and terms a buyer can understand.
ccs-resources/go-to-market/offer.content:
Turn your service into a clear result, a defined body of work and terms a buyer can understand.

## Start With What Changes For The Buyer

A business does not buy a list, AI account or number of emails for its own sake. It wants customers, revenue or valuable sales opportunities it can turn into customers.

Write who you help, the result you will work towards and how you produce it. Then make the work visible: researching the market, finding accounts, checking fit, writing the campaign, handling replies and reporting accepted opportunities, if those are actually included.

Do not add delivery you cannot perform. An SEO agency using CCS for its own acquisition still delivers its clients' SEO.

## Distinguish The Types Of Work

**Done for you:** your team completes the task. **Done with you:** you work through it together. **Training:** you explain how the buyer does it.

These are different offers. A template is not a completed website. A recruiting checklist is not a placed operator. AI writing a draft is not approved campaign management.

For every component, record what you do, the useful file or action produced, the work removed and what the client still does.

## Build The Offer File

Open the [offer template](/api/resources/download?file=ai-pack/templates/offer.md) and the [completed example](/api/resources/download?file=example/offer.md).

~~~text
Use offer-builder with my profile, research brief, proof and buyer-economics worksheet. Draft one offer in offer.md: buyer, desired result, scope, opportunity definition, work we perform, client work, timeframe, price, payment timing, minimum and remedy. Use only agreed service capabilities and terms. Mark an undecided commercial choice PROPOSED rather than already agreed. Explain why buying this removes worthwhile work or uncertainty compared with doing it internally. Return the complete offer and questions for review. Do not publish or send it.
~~~

Do not let the AI fill missing historical proof with its own example. If the terms are still proposed, that is what the file must say.

## Check Whether It Makes Sense Without The Name

Read the offer without a clever name or adjectives. Can a buyer explain what they get, how it is produced, what they must do and why the fee could make sense?

If not, fix the scope and responsibility first. Then shorten the wording.

## Check And Continue

You finish with one reviewed offer file. The [opportunity lesson](/resources/ccs-resources/go-to-market/opportunity) defines what counts. The [pricing lesson](/resources/ccs-resources/go-to-market/pricing) completes the commercial terms.

ccs-resources/go-to-market/opportunity.title: Define The Opportunity Your Client Will Pay For
ccs-resources/go-to-market/opportunity.description: Agree what counts before you charge for an opportunity or promise a delivery target.
ccs-resources/go-to-market/opportunity.content:
Agree what counts before you charge for an opportunity or promise a delivery target.

## Find The Step After A First Conversation

Ask the buyer to walk through the last sale: first contact, discussion, needs review, quotation and final decision. Find the earliest stage where both sides agree there is a useful commercial opportunity.

A booked call may be too early. A signed customer may depend on the client's sales team and delivery. Choose a stage you can influence and prove.

## Write Four Conditions

A qualified opportunity needs:

1. **Interest:** the buyer wants to discuss the actual need.
2. **Ability:** the company can commission the kind of work.
3. **Meaningful Size:** the requirement is worth the client's time and your fee.
4. **Scope:** the buyer, geography, service and timing match what was agreed.

Download the [opportunity definition](/api/resources/download?file=ai-pack/templates/opportunity-definition.md). Add exclusions, evidence, acceptance timing and dispute handling.

## Read A Complete Example

In the maintenance exercise, a plant decision-maker confirms an Ohio manufacturing-site need within 90 days and agrees to a needs review. The client confirms that the requirement is meaningful and within its capability.

The supporting reply and meeting notes are submitted for review. A failed criterion needs an explanation. A disputed row stays pending. Silence is not acceptance, and it does not trigger an invoice.

Read the [filled discovery notes](/api/resources/download?file=example/discovery-notes.md), especially D7 and D10.

## Ask AI To Find The Gaps

~~~text
Read discovery notes and offer.md. Fill opportunity-definition.md using the buyer's own sales stages. Include the four conditions, exclusions, evidence, review owner, review deadline and dispute process. Mark anything not agreed PROPOSED. Test it against one good example, one bad example and one borderline example. Do not count a meeting or invoice a milestone automatically. Return for review.
~~~

## Check And Continue

Both sides should classify the same example the same way. If they disagree, clarify the definition before launch.

Next, [Choose Your Fees And Payment Terms](/resources/ccs-resources/go-to-market/pricing).

ccs-resources/go-to-market/pricing.title: Choose Your Fees And Payment Terms
ccs-resources/go-to-market/pricing.description: Choose a payment structure that pays for the work, leaves delivery margin and gives the buyer clear protection.
ccs-resources/go-to-market/pricing.content:
Choose a payment structure that pays for the work, leaves delivery margin and gives the buyer clear protection.

## Compare The Available Structures

The [deal structures worksheet](/api/resources/download?file=ai-pack/templates/deal-structures.md) covers seven choices: monthly retainer, per lead, per call, one-time build plus ongoing operation, quarterly engagement, milestone split, and engagement fee plus performance or revenue share.

Pure performance can reduce the buyer's initial risk, but your costs arrive before their sale. Define a billable result, access to sales data, attribution, payment dates, cancellations and disputes. Revenue share without reliable reporting can leave you unpaid.

A one-time fee is paid once. Do not present it as recurring monthly income. If you spread it over a customer lifespan for modelling, label that as an average.

## Collect Enough Upfront To Fund The Work

The CCS approach here favours an upfront engagement tied to valuable opportunities rather than an endless low-price call quota. A quarterly fee or a 50/50 milestone split can fund research and setup before the outcome arrives.

The fee still needs to fit the client's economics, your delivery cost and an achievable result. Do not automatically replace every existing retainer.

Download the [cost worksheet](/api/resources/download?file=ai-pack/templates/budget.csv). Include software, data, people and your delivery time. Separate recurring and one-time costs.

## Make The Minimum And Remedy Exact

Write the promised minimum, clock start, deadline, what qualifies, what the client must do, what pauses the clock, and the remedy with its payment deadline. A target is not the same as a refund-triggering minimum.

The [completed proposal](/api/resources/download?file=example/proposal.md) shows a ten-opportunity quarterly target, a one-opportunity 45-day floor and a specific initial-payment refund. Those are designed example terms, not CCS's promise to your client.

## Check The Draft With AI

~~~text
Compare the seven deal structures against my approved scope, buyer economics and delivery budget. Recommend one and explain cash timing, delivery cost, attribution and buyer risk. Draft exact payment triggers and minimum/remedy terms in offer.md, marked PROPOSED until approved. Do not invent a margin, close rate, tax treatment or past result. Show a low-result cash scenario. Do not create a payment link or change an agreement.
~~~

## Check And Continue

You should know the cash collected at the start, later payment triggers and your cost if the result is slow. Have the contract and tax details checked through your normal advisers before actual use.

Next, [Explain Your Agency's Value In Plain Words](/resources/ccs-resources/go-to-market/positioning).

ccs-resources/go-to-market/positioning.title: Explain Your Agency's Value In Plain Words
ccs-resources/go-to-market/positioning.description: Write one clear explanation of who you help, what changes and what work you handle.
ccs-resources/go-to-market/positioning.content:
Write one clear explanation of who you help, what changes and what work you handle.

## Sell The Useful Change

“Cold email agency” names the channel. It does not tell a maintenance owner why to buy.

In the example: “We research and approach manufacturing sites with maintenance needs, then qualify the interested replies so your team can focus on suitable needs reviews.”

That explains the route without hiding it behind a grand title. Calling yourself an adviser, firm or partner does not create new delivery.

## Make The Work Visible

Explain the important steps the buyer would otherwise coordinate: market research, account selection, list checking, email writing, reply assessment and reporting. State which you actually handle.

Then state the remaining job: the client supplies accurate proof, reviews scope, attends sales discussions and delivers their service.

Do not make the pitch a tour of software names. Name AI only when explaining real work it performs.

## Produce Three Useful Versions

Open [sales-assets.md](/api/resources/download?file=ai-pack/templates/sales-assets.md). Write:

- One sentence for an email.
- A short paragraph for your website.
- A longer explanation for the proposal.

~~~text
Read my approved offer, proof and research. Write those three versions in sales-assets.md. Lead with the buyer's useful outcome and explain our actual work. Preserve responsibilities, conditions and unknowns. Remove vague labels a new buyer would not understand. Compare each claim with the source files and return the source-to-claim check. Do not invent a proprietary method or results.
~~~

## Check And Continue

Ask someone unfamiliar with your agency what it does after reading the paragraph. Their answer matters more than whether the language sounds impressive.

Next, [Use Genuine Proof And Collect Better Case Studies](/resources/ccs-resources/go-to-market/proof).

ccs-resources/go-to-market/proof.title: Use Genuine Proof And Collect Better Case Studies
ccs-resources/go-to-market/proof.description: Give the AI only the results and examples you are allowed to use.
ccs-resources/go-to-market/proof.content:
Give the AI only the results and examples you are allowed to use.

## Put Approved Evidence In One File

Use [approved-proof.md](/api/resources/download?file=ai-pack/templates/approved-proof.md). For each result, record who achieved it, what happened, period, evidence, your contribution and naming permission.

A booking screenshot proves a booking. It does not prove a signed customer or cash received. A client's revenue figure is not automatically revenue caused by your campaign.

If you have no relevant results, write NONE. You can show a real process demonstration, an illustrative strategy or relevant experience with its limits. Do not relabel someone else's results as yours.

## Interview A Client About The Change

Use the [proof interview](/api/resources/download?file=ai-pack/templates/proof-interview.md). Ask what the situation was, what was tried, what you changed, what happened, what they can evidence and what remains uncertain.

Get permission for the actual quote, name, screenshot and distribution. Keep confidential details out unless authorised.

A useful case study connects starting problem, work performed, result and period. Avoid adding an unsupported causal claim just because the sequence is persuasive.

## Have AI Draft From Evidence

~~~text
Read my approved proof file and supplied client interview. Draft a short case study with starting situation, work performed, result, period and limits. Trace numbers and quotes to evidence. Use names only where permission is recorded. If the evidence is insufficient, return a missing-evidence list and a process demonstration instead. Do not invent a testimonial or say a proposed result has happened.
~~~

## Check And Continue

Compare every quote and number to the original. The AI's draft is not permission to publish.

Return to [Prepare Your Website And Sales Materials](/resources/ccs-install/sales-materials).

ccs-resources/funnel/website.title: Build A Website That Explains The Offer
ccs-resources/funnel/website.description: Finish with a clear draft page and a booking button that leads to the correct next step.
ccs-resources/funnel/website.content:
Finish with a clear draft page and a booking button that leads to the correct next step.

## Decide What The Visitor Needs To Know

Your site should explain who you help, what result you work towards, what work you do, genuine proof and how to speak with you.

For this launch, use one focused page unless your existing site already does the job. You do not need to rebuild a working site or buy another tool just to continue.

A VSL is a video explaining the offer. Include one when it helps this visitor understand. Do not leave an empty player pretending a video exists.

## Give AI The Approved Facts

Download the [website brief](/api/resources/download?file=ai-pack/templates/website-brief.md). Use this order: headline, short explanation, useful proof or demonstration, process and work handled, fit, common questions and booking action. Add a real video only when recorded.

~~~text
Read my approved offer, proof and sales-assets.md. Fill website-brief.md and write the complete page copy. For each section explain one thing the visitor needs to understand. Use only real proof, agreed scope and an actual booking URL from settings.md. If no video exists, mark the video section NOT RECORDED and give a page version without it. Return the draft and source-to-claim check. Do not publish, connect a domain or change the current site.
~~~

Use your existing site builder. [Lovable](https://lovable.dev/) is one option from the existing CCS material, not a required subscription.

## Review It As A Visitor

Open the page at desktop and phone width. Read it without the internal brief. Check headline wrapping, paragraph width, video placement and the button.

Click every booking button and confirm the host, event, duration and time zone. Check the form receives the information you need. Viewing a calendar is not a completed test booking.

## If Something Is Wrong

A wrong booking URL can send a prospect into the wrong offer. Correct it in the brief and every button before release. If the editor cannot render the video or calendar, use a clear direct link while the integration is corrected.

## Check And Continue

You finish with reviewed page copy and a working preview. A draft is not a published site. Return to [Prepare Your Website And Sales Materials](/resources/ccs-install/sales-materials), or use the [VSL lesson](/resources/ccs-resources/funnel/vsl) if your chosen page needs one.

ccs-resources/funnel/vsl.title: Write And Record A Clear VSL
ccs-resources/funnel/vsl.description: Create a script that explains the buyer's problem, your approach and the next step.
ccs-resources/funnel/vsl.content:
Create a script that explains the buyer's problem, your approach and the next step.

## Use A Video For A Specific Job

A video sales letter, or VSL, helps a visitor understand the offer before booking. It does not replace a clear page or a useful conversation.

Use the buyer's actual questions and objections. If you do not yet have sales calls, start with research and mark assumptions for review. Do not wait for an arbitrary number of recordings.

Make the video long enough to answer the buyer's useful questions, then remove repetition. A fixed length does not guarantee more bookings.

## Draft The Script

Use [vsl-script.md](/api/resources/download?file=ai-pack/templates/vsl-script.md). Cover who it is for, the recognised problem, why it persists, what changes under your approach, actual work handled, proof or demonstration, client responsibilities and the booking action.

~~~text
Read my approved offer, proof, research and website brief. Draft a spoken VSL using vsl-script.md. Explain the result and how our real work produces it. Use the buyer's wording without inventing quotations. Mark unsupported points for review. End with the actual next step from settings.md. Add simple visual notes and a read-aloud time estimate. Do not invent results, record a video or publish.
~~~

## Record And Inspect

Read it aloud before recording. Fix sentences you would not say naturally. Record yourself using your existing recording tool.

Watch the whole export. Check sound, cuts, captions, unreadable slides and any displayed URL. On a phone, make sure text and examples can be read. Upload only the reviewed version to your chosen host, then inspect the embedded player in the page preview.

## Check And Continue

A video is ready when a new viewer can explain the offer and next action, and the actual page plays it correctly. This requires human review, not just an AI script check.

Return to [Build A Website That Explains The Offer](/resources/ccs-resources/funnel/website).

ccs-resources/funnel/calendar.title: Set Up And Check Your Booking Page
ccs-resources/funnel/calendar.description: Give suitable prospects one correct place to choose a time, with the right host and calendar.
ccs-resources/funnel/calendar.content:
Give suitable prospects one correct place to choose a time, with the right host and calendar.

## Reuse A Working Scheduler

An event type is the reusable meeting setup: host, length, availability, location and questions. A booking is one actual appointment created from it.

Use your existing scheduler if it works. For Calendly, open [Calendly](https://calendly.com/) and your Scheduling page. Create or open the one-on-one event you intend to use.

Set the event name, meeting length, video location, available hours, notice and buffers. Connect the host's real calendar and check which calendars block busy times. Record the host and time zone in settings.md.

## Keep Questions Useful

Collect name and email. Add only questions needed before this call, such as what the business sells, who buys it and why they want help.

For inbound or VSL traffic, a few qualification questions can help. Cold-email prospects may book with less form detail; complete discovery on the call.

Do not assume a direct calendar link also submitted a separate application form. Test the actual path.

## Put The Right Event On Your Site
