Use the checked system for a client without mixing their buyers, proof or permissions with your agency's.

## Confirm That This Service Fits

This route covers cold-email delivery you actually sell and can perform. It does not install SEO, paid-ad or other specialist fulfilment merely because those agencies use CCS for acquisition.

Confirm signed scope and the agreed payment/start conditions. Complete [Client Onboarding](/resources/ccs-resources/scaling-hiring/onboarding).

## Create A Separate Context

Choose clients/client-name/. Create profile, offer, proof, fit rules and settings for that business.

Your own agency may target maintenance owners. A maintenance client's campaign may target manufacturing plant managers. Their proof, offer, sender and calendar are different.

All Bots on one Grok account share the computer. Folder separation is not access control. Arrange appropriate account/workspace isolation for clients who need it.

## Prepare The New Files

~~~text
Use the completed onboarding form and accepted scope to prepare a new client-delivery folder. Apply client-profile-instruction.md. Create all five business files from that client's facts. List sender, sequencer workspace, calendar owner, approval owner and cost cap separately. Check for copied agency facts. Do not reuse old credentials, recipients or approvals. Do not create campaigns, connect tools or send anything.
~~~

## Repeat The Checks

Research this buyer, approve the offer, calibrate this list, lock this copy, check this paused campaign and practise reply/booking failures. A successful setup for one client does not prove another client's installation.

Complete a separate handover with actual account evidence, active routines and next actions. Keep the work required by the service contract assigned to the correct person.

## Check And Continue

Ask the AI to compare agency-acquisition and this client's delivery. It must identify the correct audience, offer, proof, sender, calendar and owner for each.

Return to [CCS Install](/resources/ccs-install/welcome) at the stage needed for this client, using the new folder throughout.

ccs-resources/review-status.content:
Use this page with CCS before you launch your own campaign. A completed lesson or an AI message saying “done” is not proof that your tools work.

## Check Your Saved Instructions

Open the saved skills in Grok Bot. Check the sixteen names against manifest.json and ask CCS Chief to read one back. Confirm which Bots can use them and where your own business files are stored.

## Check The Actual Campaign

Check the real account, sender, approved list, locked emails and field mapping. Inspect imported rows and rendered messages. Keep the campaign paused until the owner approves launch. A practice file or screenshot from the worked example is not a real import check.

## Check Replies And Booking

Prepare a controlled test using internal inboxes and a test calendar. The owner must approve the exact copy, recipients, sender, channel and meeting details before anything is sent or booked. Check reply handling, opt-outs, duplicate events, available times, the resulting appointment and sequence-stop behaviour. Record failures and fix them before launch.

## Confirm Who Does Each Job

Record who checks daily replies, approves actions, reviews the weekly report, handles problems and confirms handover. Use your existing CCS support or coaching channel if you are stuck. Do not assume AI takes a job merely because a skill describes it.

## Keep Evidence And Unknowns Separate

The downloadable worked example is illustrative and uses simulated events. Local tests check files and safety logic. They do not prove your Grok installation, lead quality, email delivery, sales or profitability. Mark your own uncompleted checks NOT TESTED.

The included collector and local company cache can prepare evidence and proposed analyses. Automatic paid-model calls and automatic browser fallbacks are not included. Use the guided manual route until CCS agrees and checks any additional integration and its spending cap.

## Finish With CCS

Bring your completed checklist, file versions, actual test results and unresolved errors to [Review And Launch Your Campaign With CCS](/resources/ccs-install/launch-review). Complete [Your Handover](/resources/ccs-install/handover) before using Training as the operating routine for a live system.
